text:
alex: morning check-in — what I did: merged rate-policy change that adds weight-based routing fallback and a tiny circuit for overloaded backends; ran a 10% canary in staging. blocker: CI integration tests flaking because of short secrets rotation window; need to extend. today: debug CI flakes, pair with @kevin on canary metrics and decide promote timing.

maria: saw the PR, left a couple of nits around config validation. also noticed jwt middleware drops when `kid` header is missing — will open an issue.

kevin: can pair at 10:30 PT. saw a small p99 increase (~5ms) on sequences >1024 in the canary — looks like KV cache misses when prefix caching fails. digging into kernel selection logs.

sam: FYI I pushed a token-rotation hotfix to staging to prevent 401 spikes; need someone to run a quick smoke against the gateway after promote. @jess?

jess: I can run a smoke at 11:00. which curl should I use? any specific headers to exercise routing?

alex: use this quick sample:```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -X POST https://gw.staging.redwood.ai/v1/route -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"ping"}'```should return 200 with body containing "pong" and x-route-id header.

maria: small perf note — to measure single-token latency include `Prefer-Batch: never` header; that isolates batching effects.

deploy-bot: deploy started for canary/weight-routing - build #4521 — routing rules active at 10% traffic. CI status: pending.

kevin: checking logs: saw ~1/1000 429s during the 10% canary window at 03:15 UTC; pattern looks like client retry storm. experimenting with adding jittered backoff and token-bucket tweaks.

alex: blocker update: got a temporary CI workaround in #4523 but would like to extend secrets rotation window to 5m for the canary rollout to avoid transient auth failures. will file a short RFC for the change.

sam: on rate limits — reducing default burst from 200 -> 50 reduces 429s but breaks some internal batchers. proposing an exceptions list under `routes.exceptions` for internal integrations/* so we don't regress them.

jess: +1 to an exceptions allowlist. we can surface it in Console -> Routes -> Exceptions and gate by team.

maria: left review comment requesting an extra metric (per-route kv-cache hit rate) before approving. once metric is in, I'll approve.

alex: pinging folks for approvals so we can promote to 25% by 12:00 PT if no regressions.

kevin: ack — finishing a log sweep and will report back by 11:45 PT.

sam: infra side no blockers. happy to help with exception rules if needed.

jess: smoke run complete at 11:07 — happy path OK, no 5xx observed, auth headers validated. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks all — if no other issues I'll promote after kevin's final check. :party:
